annotations.title: Citation checker for RAG / AI answers

description: Citation checker for RAG / AI answers — Checks whether each [n]-cited sentence in an AI answer (answer=) is actually supported by the cited source. Sources via sources= (JSON array of strings or {id,text,url}) or urls= (comma list, numbered 1..n, fetched). Per sentence: SUPPORTED/PARTIAL/NOT_SUPPORTED/CONTRADICTED with a supporting quote that is verified against the source offline; also flags citations to missing sources and uncited factual sentences. Returns citation accuracy, coverage and a verdict (WELL_CITED/PARTLY_SUPPORTED/POORLY_CITED/MISCITED). Price: $0.012 USDC (Base, via x402).

answer.description: e.g. The Eiffel Tower was completed in 1889 [1]. It is 330 metres tall [1].

sources.description: e.g. ["The Eiffel Tower was completed in 1889 for the World Fair. It is 330 metres (1,083 ft) tall."]

name: ai_citation_check
